name: Stolen Silver
summary: Gazrog at the Crossroads sends you after payroll silver stolen by raptors. Rumors of their cunning lead you south of Ratchet, into the Raptor Grounds. The garrison needs its wages back.

sections.title: A Beastly Heist
sections.body: Gazrog needs the Crossroads guards paid, and the raptors have taken their wages. You are sent to recover the stolen coin, not simply punish the beasts. When raptors ambushed the payroll shipment, Gazrog first sought vengeance. But killing the pack would not restore the missing money. The Horde must learn how the raptors carried off heavy crates of coin, and where they took them.

sections.title: The Raptor Grounds
sections.body: Scouts found a raptor nest between two craggy peaks, south of Ratchet and northwest of Northwatch Hold. The creatures dragged the intact lockbox into their territory, where they guard it alongside eggs and fresh kills. Tales of raptor cunning and hoarding now seem true to Gazrog. Ordinary beasts rarely stash metallic valuables.

faq.q: Why did raptors steal silver in the first place?
faq.answer: Barrens raptors show startling cunning and curious scavenging habits. They dragged the intact strongbox to their communal nests in the Raptor Grounds, perhaps drawn by its shine, the treated leather on the chest, or a hoarding instinct.
Gazrog is an orc officer stationed in the Crossroads' main bunker. He manages security and logistics, including threats from local wildlife, centaur incursions, and payroll disruptions.

faq.q: Where are the Raptor Grounds located?
faq.answer: The Raptor Grounds lie in eastern Barrens, south of Ratchet and northwest of Northwatch Hold. Their nests fill a rugged passage between two mountains.

faq.q: What happens if the silver is not recovered?
faq.answer: The stolen silver holds a month's wages for the Crossroads guards. Without it, the outpost's defenders face working without pay, and morale may suffer at a fortress beset by quilboar, centaur, and Alliance raiders.

faq.q: Is this part of a longer quest chain?
faq.answer: Before you search for the cache, you must complete Raptor Thieves for Gazrog. There, you cull the raptors that attacked the first transport and track down the stash's location.

faq.q: Is the Alliance involved in the theft?
faq.answer: No. Northwatch Hold lies southeast of the Raptor Grounds, but native raptors carried out the theft. Their thievery and hoarding surprised even veteran Horde commanders.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you know the Crossroads keeps its guards paid and fed to hold the Kalimdor frontier.
As a hunter, you see Barrens raptors nesting in complex social groups and drawn to artificial, shiny cargo.
